name: Potion Refill
description: When you drink a potion from your belt, a matching potion from your inventory moves into the same belt column. Needs D2RLoader and the d2rl-potion-refill.dll plugin copied into <game>\d2rloader\plugins (D2RMM cannot install DLLs). Launch the game with D2RLoader using D2RMM's output mod.
author: Juan

config.name: Enabled
config.description: Refill the belt column you drink from.

config.name: Matching
config.description: Which inventory potions can refill a belt column.

options.label: Same kind
options.description: Any healing potion refills healing, any mana potion refills mana, any rejuvenation potion refills rejuvenation. The same potion is used first, then the closest size.

options.label: Exact potion
options.description: Only the same potion, such as Super Healing for Super Healing.
